about: Published training lists of released ink models, each name resolved to an open-data catalog segment where one matches, for kit/expatlas.py. role: train (its training data), train_split (in a dataset its published split rule draws training patches from), validation (chose its checkpoint), validation_only (in its dataset, but the split rule gives it no training patch), selected (its authors chose the checkpoint on it), test (its own list holds it out), not_trained (an author's statement that a scroll (segment *) was not trained on; it lets a cell read clear where the list itself is not fully published). segment null: no catalog segment matched, so only the name is known. Catalog: metadata.json Last-Modified 2026-11-02.
